I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are untested.

- **Content:** it has the "New request" heading, the five fields, and the "Cancel" and "Create Request" buttons, all as you specified. The heading is shown in all caps through CSS.
- **Layout:** everything sits inside `#component` at 1280px wide. The form card spans columns 3 to 10 of the 12-column grid, with 64px page margins and 32px gutters.
- **Design rules:** I followed DESIGN.md for the colors, type sizes and radii. The buttons are pills at least 44px tall, and the labels are 12px all-caps in the accent blue. Hover and focus states use only the listed colors, and transitions stop when reduced motion is set.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't be loaded, since the folder has no font files. They only render if installed locally. Otherwise the page falls back to the system sans-serif.
- **Defaults I chose:** Priority starts on Medium and Assignee on Maya Chen. I added no placeholder text.
